objects.description: During [Operation Sharpshooter](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0013), threat actors installed [Rising Sun](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0448) in the Startup folder and disguised it as `mssync.exe`.(Citation: McAfee Sharpshooter December 2018)
objects.description_fa: در طول [عملیات Sharpshooter](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0013)، عوامل تهدید [Rising Sun](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0448) را در پوشه Startup نصب کردند و آن را به عنوان «mssync.exe» پنهان کردند.(Citation: McAfee Sharpshooter December 2018)
